_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/targets/test_opponent_or_planeswalker.py. t_oop_pinger is Theater of Horrors' activated ability on its own: one 'any' target whose player_selector narrows only the player half to opponents, its selector the permanent half to planeswalkers of any controller. t_oop_narrow is the near miss with controller 'opponent' in the selector, which also drops your own planeswalkers; t_oop_wide the other, with no controller at all, which lets you target yourself.

cards.name: Test Opponent or Planeswalker Pinger
cards.oracle_text: {R}: This enchantment deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
